name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: Token rate monitor: per-question instant tokens/sec from the ZCode usage DB, shown at the end of each tool-using reply; /tps command, MCP tools, and a real-time dashboard. Supports a real metrics URL or built-in demo data for service TPS.

metrics_url.title: Metrics URL
metrics_url.description: HTTP endpoint returning JSON with a tps/qps field; empty = demo data.
